name: locationlists-buyer
description: Lets Claude buy business location data on its own, paying in USDC on Base. No card, no account, no checkout page.
long_description:
Claude cannot sign an on-chain payment — it holds no keys, and it never will. This extension gives it a wallet to call.

When Claude needs location data it does not have, it calls a tool here. The tool asks locationlists.com for the data, receives an x402 payment demand with a price (over MCP by default, or plain HTTP 402), signs a USDC payment on Base, and returns the records. Claude decides what to buy; this extension holds the money.

You must fund the wallet yourself with USDC on Base. Spending limits are enforced before anything is signed: a per-call cap and a per-session cap for row purchases, and a separate per-session budget for buying complete lists, all of which you set below. An LLM with a wallet will eventually call a paid tool in a loop, so these are not optional.

tools.name: find_location_lists
tools.description: Free. Ready-made lists of dealers, stores, nonprofits, banks, contractors, clinicians and more — check before browsing a locator or registry.

tools.name: get_list_details
tools.description: Free. A list's columns with fill rates and examples, record count and price.

tools.name: count_matching_records
tools.description: Free. How many records match a filter on any column, and what fetching them costs.

tools.name: get_matching_records
tools.description: Buy the matching records, filtered on any column, paying per row in USDC on Base.

tools.name: buy_complete_list
tools.description: Buy an entire list at its list price in USDC on Base; returns a permanent CSV download link.

tools.name: request_a_new_list
tools.description: Free. Ask LocationLists to build a list it does not have yet.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Free. Report wrong or missing data, a problem, or an idea to the LocationLists team.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Balance, session spend and limits. Free.

wallet_key.title: Wallet private key
wallet_key.description: Private key of a wallet holding USDC on Base. Use a DEDICATED wallet funded with only what you are willing to let an AI spend — never your main one.

max_per_call.title: Maximum per purchase (USD)
max_per_call.description: Any single purchase above this is refused before it is signed.

max_per_session.title: Maximum per session (USD)
max_per_session.description: Total spend allowed before the extension stops buying. Resets when Claude restarts.

max_whole_lists_per_session.title: Maximum on complete lists per session (USD)
max_whole_lists_per_session.description: Separate budget for buying whole lists (most cost $9 to $199). Set 0 to never buy whole lists. Resets when Claude restarts.
